verdict.rationale: The API is documented as providing full parity with the web client and returns data via a REST/JSON interface with a published OpenAPI spec, which in principle lets a user programmatically pull out all their records in an open format. However, there is no explicit documentation of a native bulk-export/backup feature, no mention of CSV/Excel/JSON export tools, and no discussion of account closure or full data portability workflows. Missing for 10: a documented one-click 'export all data' or backup feature, explicit open-format (CSV/JSON) export tooling, and any statement about data portability/lock-in-free exit.
